PreToolUse.hook: echo 'PRE-COMMIT CHECK: Ensure CHANGELOG.md is updated, Sprint-Log.md reflects progress, and commit message follows conventional format (feat:/fix:/docs:/test:/refactor:/chore:/security:)'

PostToolUse.hook: echo 'POST-PUSH: Sync GitHub Wiki now! Run: cd /tmp && ([ -d ideate.wiki ] || git clone https://github.com/dobrician/ideate.wiki.git) && cp /home/dc/work/ideate/docs/wiki/*.md /tmp/ideate.wiki/ && cd /tmp/ideate.wiki && git add -A && git diff --cached --quiet || (git commit -m "docs: sync wiki" && git push)'
echo 'POST-DEPLOY: Run smoke tests! Execute: npm run test:smoke against the deployed container. Deploy is NOT complete until smoke tests pass.'

Stop.hook:
echo '
=== SPRINT TASK COMPLETE ===
Before stopping, verify:
1. ✅ CHANGELOG.md updated
2. ✅ docs/wiki/Sprint-Log.md task checked off
3. ✅ GitHub Wiki synced
4. ✅ All tests passing
5. ✅ README.md still accurate
6. ✅ Any new issues created for discovered problems
7. ✅ Commit messages reference issue numbers where applicable (fixes #N)
========================'
